title: What If Venice Flooded Almost Six Feet Deep? In 2019 It Did

scenes.text: What if a famous city flooded almost six feet deep? Venice did in 2019.
On November 12, 2019, the tide reached 187 centimeters above sea level.
Only one flood had been higher: 193 centimeters on November 4, 1966.
Venice then built MOSE, a system of movable barriers at the lagoon's entrances, to hold the sea out.
In November 2022 a tide of 173 centimeters was forecast, and the barriers were raised.
Officials said that without MOSE, about 82 percent of Venice would have been underwater.
